system.name: BatchGen
system.one_liner: a batch inference architecture that models sequence computation as fine-grained, event-driven coroutines

components.name: OpenAI Batch API-Compatible HTTP Server
components.role: receives submitted batch jobs from users

components.name: Master Node
components.role: coordinates request/response queues, offline profiling, and plan optimization

components.name: Request Queue
components.role: holds submitted requests before batch split

components.name: Response Queue
components.role: holds results before merging back to the user

components.name: Plan Optimizer
components.role: computes an execution plan for batch splitting/scheduling

components.name: Worker Node 0
components.role: executes assigned requests using local coroutine runtime and GPUs

components.name: Local Controller
components.role: coordinates the components within a worker node

components.name: Coroutine Runtime
components.role: runs the batch-oriented inference engine and scheduler for this worker

components.name: Scheduler
components.role: dispatches sequence coroutines within the worker

components.name: GPU Pool
components.role: GPU compute resources on the worker node

components.name: Model Weights Manager
components.role: manages model weights on the worker node

components.name: KV-cache Manager
components.role: manages KV-cache on the worker node

content.key_idea: BatchGen is organized as a master node that exposes an OpenAI Batch API-compatible endpoint, profiles and plans batch splits, and dispatches work to worker nodes running a local coroutine runtime, GPU pool, and state managers.
content.reading_order: Top-down: a user submits a job to the HTTP server, which flows into the Master Node's request/response queues and offline profiler/plan optimizer, then down through a Local Controller into the Worker Node's coroutine runtime, GPU pool, and weight/cache managers.

request/response queues flanking a central planning component

evidence: Figure 8 shows the BatchGen system architecture for deployment at scale
control plane implemented on an industrially customized Ray

summary: This figure shows BatchGen's deployment-scale system architecture with a master-worker organization. Users submit jobs through an OpenAI Batch API-compatible HTTP server. The Master Node holds a Request Queue and Response Queue flanking an Offline Profiler and Plan Optimizer that together drive batch splitting and results merging. Below, one or more Worker Nodes (Worker Node 0 shown) each run a Local Controller coordinating a Coroutine Runtime (Batch Oriented Inference Engine plus Scheduler), a GPU Pool, a Health Monitor, a Model Weights Manager, and a KV-cache Manager. The grayscale, flat, top-down layered diagram separates the control-plane planning logic on top from the data-plane execution resources below, illustrating how BatchGen's control plane, built on a customized Ray, dispatches batched sequence coroutine work onto worker-node GPU pools.
summary_zh: 该图展示BatchGen大规模部署架构：用户通过兼容OpenAI Batch API的HTTP服务器提交任务，主节点含请求/响应队列及离线分析器与计划优化器，工作节点内本地控制器协调协程运行时、GPU池、健康监控、模型权重与KV缓存管理器。
